stories.title: Moraes chama relatório apresentado por Mendonça de farsa e diz que é vingança após condenações na trama golpista

en.title: Moraes calls report presented by Mendonça a farce and says it is revenge after convictions in coup plot
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes stated that a report presented by Justice André Mendonça shows no evidence warranting investigation of criminal infractions, which the court will analyze.

stories.title: Porto do Açu prepara produção de combustível sustentável para navio; veja como será

en.title: Porto do Açu prepares sustainable fuel production for ships; see how it will work
en.summary: Porto do Açu in Rio de Janeiro has launched a project to produce synthetic fuel through carbon capture for maritime transport use at its port complex.

stories.title: Indústria aposta em selo digital para barrar bebidas falsificadas; veja como funciona

en.title: Industry bets on digital seal to stop counterfeit beverages; see how it works
en.summary: The beverage industry is implementing a digital seal technology designed to prevent the distribution and sale of counterfeit drinks.

stories.title: Brasília vive clima de 'Fla x Flu' pré-julgamento de Moraes no STF: ministros tentaram adiar sessão, sem sucesso

en.title: Brasília lives climate of 'Fla x Flu' before Moraes judgment at STF: ministers attempted to postpone session without success
en.summary: Tension grips Brasília ahead of a Supreme Court session examining the relationship between Justice Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding a banking scandal.

stories.title: Moraes, Vorcaro, Mendonça, Fachin, Gonet: relembre os principais personagens da crise Master do STF

en.title: Moraes, Vorcaro, Mendonça, Fachin, Gonet: recall the main figures in the Supreme Court crisis
en.summary: The Brazilian Supreme Court is holding a plenary session to judge the validity of a Federal Police report examining messages and connections between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Justice Alexandre de Moraes, a case that has triggered institutional tensions and disputes among magistrates.

stories.title: Veja como será a sessão do STF sobre relatório da PF com mensagens trocadas entre Vorcaro e Moraes

en.title: See how the Supreme Court session on the Federal Police report with messages exchanged between Vorcaro and Moraes will be
en.summary: The Supreme Court meets in an extraordinary session to judge a Federal Police report on messages exchanged between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Justice Alexandre de Moraes, with the detailed procedure announced for 10 a.m. on Tuesday, though several procedural questions remain open.

stories.title: Após crise do metanol, garrafas ganham selo que permite detectar bebidas falsificadas pelo celular

en.title: After methanol crisis, bottles gain seal that allows detecting counterfeit beverages through cell phone
en.summary: Following a methanol intoxication crisis in 2025 that caused at least 25 deaths, the beverage industry is implementing a seal technology enabling consumers to verify product authenticity via mobile phone to address both public health and counterfeit product concerns.

stories.title: Cacique Raoni é diagnosticado com câncer aos 94 anos e recebe cuidados paliativos

en.title: Cacique Raoni is diagnosed with cancer at 94 years old and receives palliative care
en.summary: Indigenous leader Cacique Raoni has been diagnosed with cancer at age 94 and is receiving palliative care.

stories.title: Julgamento de Alexandre de Moraes: o que sabe sobre sessão inédita do STF

en.title: Trial of Alexandre de Moraes: what is known about unprecedented STF session
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court is evaluating whether to open investigations against Justice Alexandre de Moraes, with key questions about the session being addressed.

stories.title: Cacique Raoni, de 94 anos, recebe cuidados paliativos em Mato Grosso

en.title: Chief Raoni, 94 years old, receives palliative care in Mato Grosso
en.summary: Indigenous leader Raoni Metuktire, diagnosed with digestive cancer, is receiving palliative care at home in Peixoto de Azevedo while being cared for by family and medical staff.

stories.title: Delegados discutiram relatório sobre Moraes em março e relataram pressões a Mendonça; leia bastidor

en.title: Police chiefs discussed report on Moraes in March and reported pressures to Mendonça; read behind-the-scenes
en.summary: Police delegates discussed a report concerning Justice Moraes in March and reported experiencing pressures to Attorney General Mendonça.

stories.title: Moraes diz que relatório apresentado por Mendonça é 'farsa' e vinganca de aliados de condenados pela trama golpista

en.title: Moraes says report presented by Mendonça is 'farce' and revenge by allies of those convicted in coup plot
en.summary: Justice Moraes characterizes a report presented by Attorney General Mendonça as a fabrication and act of retaliation by supporters of those convicted in a coup conspiracy.

stories.title: Crise na construção civil faz queda nos investimentos da China se aprofundar

en.title: Crisis in construction causes China's investment decline to deepen
en.summary: China's investment fell further in August as consumer spending remained below expectations, with the prolonged downturn in real estate continuing to pressure domestic demand.

stories.title: Lockheed Martin fecha contrato bilionário com o Exército dos EUA

en.title: Lockheed Martin closes billion-dollar contract with US Army
en.summary: Lockheed Martin received a 1.21 billion dollar order to help manufacture missiles for the United States Army.

stories.title: Petrobras fecha contrato de 20 anos com Sempra Infrastructure para compra de GNL

en.title: Petrobras closes 20-year contract with Sempra Infrastructure for LNG purchase
en.summary: Petrobras signed a long-term liquefied natural gas purchase agreement with Sempra Infrastructure for 0.8 million tonnes annually over 20 years, supplied from Port Arthur, Texas.

stories.title: CFM proíbe uso do PMMA como preenchedor no Brasil

en.title: CFM prohibits use of PMMA as filler in Brazil
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Council of Medicine banned medical use of PMMA-based products as injectable fillers for skin or soft tissue augmentation, with exceptions for HIV-related facial lipodystrophy treatment.

stories.title: Gilmar Mendes pede vista e suspende julgamento sobre contrato do BRB com tribunal baiano

en.title: Gilmar Mendes requests additional time and suspends ruling on BRB contract with Bahia court
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court suspended a judgment on a ruling by Justice Luiz Fux that extended a 90-day deposit contract between Bahia's Court of Justice and Banco de Brasília. Justice Gilmar Mendes requested more time for analysis.
